patthana19.5:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā. na saṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭha asaṃkilesiko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.5:2.1: na asaṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭha asaṃkilesiko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, pañca.
patthana19.5:3.1: na asaṃkiliṭṭha asaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, na asaṃkiliṭṭha asaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
